description: A React component named DetailsViewer that renders detailed views of objects or arrays with features like collapsible sections, formatted fields, raw JSON toggle, and agent-specific interactions. It is designed for use within a data management dashboard frontend.

classes.name: Collapser
classes.description: A React component used internally to provide collapsible sections within the DetailsViewer, managing expand/collapse state and accessibility features.

methods.name: safePretty
methods.description: Converts a payload to a pretty-printed JSON string with fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: toLabel
methods.description: Formats a key into a user-friendly label using formatLabel utility.

methods.name: isTimestampLike
methods.description: Checks if a key resembles a timestamp or date field.

methods.name: isTokenLike
methods.description: Checks if a key resembles token count fields.

methods.name: isDurationLike
methods.description: Checks if a key resembles duration or latency fields.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Formats a numeric value into a human-readable duration string.

methods.name: isCurrencyKeyLoose
methods.description: Determines if a key name loosely indicates a currency or cost field.

methods.name: formatValueByKey
methods.description: Formats a value based on its key, applying special formatting for currency, tokens, timestamps, or durations.

methods.name: initialCollapsed
methods.description: Decides if a section should be collapsed initially based on depth.

methods.name: renderPrimitiveVal
methods.description: Renders a primitive value with appropriate styling and formatting.

methods.name: extractAgentIdentity
methods.description: Extracts agent ID and name from an object, used for agent array rendering.

methods.name: renderNode
methods.description: Recursively renders a node (object, array, or primitive) with collapsible sections for complex structures.

methods.name: renderEntries
methods.description: Renders key-value entries of an object, with highlighted keys prioritized and optional emphasis styling.
